races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
MAJESTIC FLAME caught the eye in a strong maiden here last month and gets the nod in what is likely to prove an informative contest. Lily Pink and Rhythm of My Heart head the list of dangers.

  1. MAJESTIC FLAME
  2. LILY PINK
  3. RHYTHM OF MY HEART

races.name: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Handicap
races.verdict:
FORTY YEARS ON boasts an excellent strike rate and upped her game further when scoring at Newbury in June. With further progress on the cards, she looks the one to beat here. Completely Random and Ghost Mode may provide the chief threat.

  1. FORTY YEARS ON (IRE)
  2. COMPLETELY RANDOM
  3. GHOST MODE (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This can go to TONY MONTANA, who ran a cracker in a much stronger contest here last month and remains fairly treated. Too Soon and High Degree rate the principal dangers.

  1. TONY MONTANA
  2. TOO SOON
  3. HIGH DEGREE

races.name: Virgin Bet Celebration Mile Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
Sole 3-y-o ZAVATERI has had a relatively light season and shaped as if the step back up to this trip would suit when fifth at York last week. He could be the answer here. Boiling Point rarely runs a bad race and looks sure to make his presence felt, whilst Seagulls Eleven is much better than he showed here last time and is also respected.

  1. ZAVATERI (IRE)
  2. BOILING POINT (IRE)
  3. SEAGULLS ELEVEN (IRE)

races.name: Darley EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
EVENING CALL should have learnt plenty from her recent encouraging Newmarket debut and is taken to get off the mark. Tropical Sands may provide the chief threat of those with experience, whilst the newcomers Marquetry and Queen of Scotland both appeal on paper.

  1. EVENING CALL
  2. TROPICAL SANDS
  3. MARQUETRY (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ZACHARY HICKES has few miles on the clock and displayed a good attitude when opening his account at Yarmouth earlier this month. This stiffer test of stamina promises to suit and he is taken to follow up. Arcturus Flame and Educator are feared most.

  1. ZACHARY HICKES
  2. ARCTURUS FLAME (IRE)
  3. EDUCATOR

races.name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
DYONISOS didn't get the breaks in a deeper contest here last time and makes plenty of appeal in the finale. All Ways Glamorous and Dream Composer are also of interest.

  1. DYONISOS (FR)
  2. ALL WAYS GLAMOROUS
  3. DREAM COMPOSER (FR)

races.name: John Ormonde Wexford Sand Irish European Breeders Fund (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
Aidan O'Brien has a strong record in this maiden and looks to hold a strong hand once again. Ryan Moore is on Leopardstown third DARKNESS FALLS so he's narrowly preferred to stablemate Albany County, an encouraging fourth on his recent course debut. Group entries suggest newcomers Paul Pierre, Cluster and Kingdom of Camelot, another from Ballydoyle, are well regarded.

  1. DARKNESS FALLS (IRE)
  2. ALBANY COUNTY (IRE)
  3. PAUL PIERRE (IRE)

races.name: Newtownanner Stud Irish European Breeders Fund Stakes (Fillies' Group 3)
races.verdict:
BELLESQUE continued her race-by-race progression when third in listed company at Gowran last time, despite not being seen to best effect, and she can provide her yard with back-to-back wins in this contest. There could be better to come from Samnina upped to 1m and she isn't taken lightly, with So Lovely the pick of Aidan O'Brien's trio.

  1. BELLESQUE (IRE)
  2. SAMNINA (IRE)
  3. SO LOVELY (USA)

races.name: Audi Naas Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
MARGOT MAE seems set to be suited by the conditions and is weighted to make a winning nursery debut. The forecast rain shouldn't inconvenience Banks Of The Boyne, either, and he looks the most likely danger. Expensive colt Tradewinds is another to consider tackling 7f for the first time.

  1. MARGOT MAE (IRE)
  2. BANKS OF THE BOYNE (IRE)
  3. TRADEWINDS (IRE)

races.name: Heider Family Stables Round Tower Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
A good-looking renewal of this Group 3 based on Timeform pre-race ratings. Unbeaten No Nay Never Colt GREAT BARRIER REEF did well to land the Coventry Stakes at Royal Ascot and, while it’s a slight concern he’s not been seen since, he’s still taken to overcome a 5 lb penalty and provide Aidan O’Brien with a third successive win in the race. Livenka certainly impressed in landing the odds at Naas and is feared most.

  1. GREAT BARRIER REEF (IRE)
  2. LIVENKA
  3. VELOZEE (IRE)

races.name: Snow Fairy Fillies Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Group 3)
races.verdict:
Having quickly developed into a smart performer in 2025, FAIYUM made a promising return in Group 3 at this course and can build on that effort at the second attempt with her yard amongst the winners. She gets the vote ahead of Miss Scott, who could still have more to offer, while Bosphorus Rose is another to consider.

  1. FAIYUM
  2. MISS SCOTT (IRE)
  3. BOSPHORUS ROSE

races.name: Tote Irish Cambridgeshire (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
One of Ireland's premier handicaps and it looks another typically competitive renewal. PIERRE ROYAL is still relatively unexposed after just 7 career starts and once again left the impression there's a valuable 1m handicap with his name on it when fourth in another strongly-contested event at the Galway Festival on his latest outing. Loughrea is progressing notably well and looks the type to win more races, while Johnny Sodaa, Kalir and Hellorhighwater are others to take seriously.

  1. PIERRE ROYAL (IRE)
  2. LOUGHREA (IRE)
  3. JOHNNY SODA (IRE)

races.name: Holden Plant Rentals Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
TAWAAZON’s sole win last season came over C&D and, having been the first one home in the unfavoured group at Naas last weekend, he’s taken to strike. Naoi is open to further improvement on the back of her recent winning return for a new yard, with Rosato and Simmering Seas completing the shortlist.

  1. TAWAAZON (IRE)
  2. NAOI (IRE)
  3. ROSATO (IRE)

races.name: Pat Smullen Cancer Trials Ireland Charity Race Supported By Ballylinch Stud
Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The opener can go the way of MINSTER MAN, who learnt plenty from his first outing when making all in good style at Musselburgh earlier this month. Crazee In Havana was much improved from his debut when going well for a long way at Sandown and could be the biggest threat, ahead of last-time-out winner Roxa Love.

  1. MINSTER MAN (IRE)
  2. CRAZEE IN HAVANA
  3. ROXA LOVE

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Nursery
races.verdict:
Successful on his third start, DOWMAN ran well switched to a nursery when bumping into an improver at Yarmouth last time and he can resume winning ways at this level. He gets the vote ahead of Sea Palace, who heads into nursery company after only the 2 starts, with Leicester scorer Pj's Corner completing the shortlist.

  1. DOWMAN (IRE)
  2. SEA PALACE
  3. PJ'S CORNER

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FLIGHT TRACKER has a fine pedigree and can open his account at the second time of asking. Newcomers Saxon Lodge and Mainshock are considered, especially if supported.

  1. FLIGHT TRACKER
  2. SAXON LODGE (IRE)
  3. MAINSHOCK (USA)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Nursery
races.verdict:
NO MORE PINO has fared better switched to nurseries the last twice, leading until the closing stages at Lingfield on Thursday, so he could be the answer as he drops back down in trip. So Tempting was runner-up here on her penultimate start and is next on the list in a change of headgear, with Absolute Diamond also considered.

  1. NO MORE PINO (IRE)
  2. SO TEMPTING
  3. ABSOLUTE DIAMOND (IRE)

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
EMERY DOWN is on a dangerous mark if bouncing back from a lesser effort on the all-weather last time. She's narrowly preferred to Rosemary's Rose and Kaleidoscope Eyes, who both arrive in good nick. Dappled Light is another to consider if lining up.

  1. EMERY DOWN
  2. ROSEMARY'S ROSE (IRE)
  3. KALEIDOSCOPE EYES (IRE)

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
DASH OF CLASS has run well here previously, and she gets the vote in a tricky handicap. Fellow 3-y-os Head Girl and Heart Sign also make appeal, with Buck Barrow the pick of those with proven soft-ground form.

  1. DASH OF CLASS
  2. HEAD GIRL
  3. HEART SIGN

races.name: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for CITY ESCAPE, who figures off a handy mark and came from last to first when scoring at Ffos Las last week. Knightmare and Celebrating Ethel rate the principal dangers.

  1. CITY ESCAPE (IRE)
  2. KNIGHTMARE (IRE)
  3. CELEBRATING ETHEL (IRE)

races.name: Tattersalls 40,000 EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
THI QAR has been entered in Group races on the back of her encouraging debut second at Newmarket and is taken to improve past the more-established Tall Trees. Money for one or more of the newcomers would also bring them into the reckoning, with Flower Show one who makes obvious appeal given Charlie Appleby's excellent 2-y-o strike-rate.

  1. THI QAR (IRE)
  2. TALL TREES
  3. FLOWER SHOW (IRE)

races.name: Zyn Frontrunner Finish Handicap
races.verdict:
The handicapper hasn't missed KOKBASTAU after Kempton but it still might not stop this fast-improving 3-y-o. Fellow 3-y-o My Love Is King failed to figure in a Group 3 at Royal Ascot but retains potential back from a break and is second choice ahead of Alcarath and last year's Balmoral winner Crown of Oaks, who has been given a bit of time to get over a below-par reappearance in Ireland.

  1. KOKBASTAU
  2. MY LOVE IS KING
  3. ALCARATH (IRE)

races.name: BetMGM Atalanta Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Group 3)
races.verdict:
A competitive Group 3. SECRET OF LIFE has made rapid progress and is taken to make it 4-4 but there are a few potential big threats to her unbeaten record, namely Kon Tiki, Moon Target, who has been holding her own in Group 1s, Calendar Girl and So Regal.

  1. SECRET OF LIFE
  2. KON TIKI
  3. MOON TARGET

races.name: BetMGM Solario Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
This looks a good renewal. ROCK MONTREAL created a very good impression on his recent Yarmouth debut and gets a narrow vote over Sonic Angel, who looks another highly talented juvenile for the Crisford yard. Easy York scorer Mia Fantasia and Breacher complete the shortlist.

  1. ROCK MONTREAL (IRE)
  2. SONIC ANGEL
  3. MIA FANTASIA (IRE)

races.name: Download The BetMGM App Handicap
races.verdict:
DESERT SHADOW had so much to spare over C&D last time that even a 9 lb rise may not stop him. God of War catches the eye having dropped to 4 lb below the mark he defied in this race last year and is second choice. Shameful has been off the track for a long time but Clive Cox has his team in form and a good record fresh means it would be no surprise were this low-mileage 4-y-o to make an impact.

  1. DESERT SHADOW
  2. GOD OF WAR
  3. SHAMEFUL (IRE)

races.name: BetMGM Real Deal Nursery
races.verdict:
LA FUERZA looks nicely treated given the way his Wolverhampton form has worked out and he's preferred to Sanbona Warrior and Noble Prince in this useful nursery

  1. LA FUERZA (IRE)
  2. SANBONA WARRIOR (IRE)
  3. NOBLE PRINCE

races.name: Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap
races.verdict:
Harry Charlton's lightly-raced HYPNOTISED still looked something of a work in progress when going down narrowly at Newbury last time and looks the way to go here. Rosario arrives on a losing run but now figures on an attractive mark and is next on the list, while Zoulu Chief also enters the reckoning on the back of a promising recent Newmarket ninth.

  1. HYPNOTISED
  2. ROSARIO (IRE)
  3. ZOULU CHIEF

races.name: Blink And You Miss It Sprint Handicap
races.verdict:
SOLAR ACLAIM had excuses on account of the ground/way the race developed at Chester when last seen in June and is on a workable mark judged on the pick of last season's efforts, so could be worth chancing to quickly bounce back. This is competitive though, with Sir Yoshi and Newcastle scorer Lethal Nymph just 2 potential threats.

  1. SOLAR ACLAIM (IRE)
  2. SIR YOSHI (IRE)
  3. LETHAL NYMPH

races.name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Hull Handicap
races.verdict:
PRINCE OF CALYPSO did well under the circumstances when opening his account over this trip at Wolverhampton 12 days ago, quickening well to lead dying strides. He could have more to offer and earns the vote to follow up from a 5 lb higher mark, with class-dropping L'Eagle Aid firmly expected to give Ed Bethell's 3-y-o plenty to think about. Northern Brave and Valley of Flowers are others worth a look.

  1. PRINCE OF CALYPSO (IRE)
  2. L'EAGLE AID (IRE)
  3. NORTHERN BRAVE (IRE)

races.name: Dearing Plastics Celebrating 40 Years Handicap
races.verdict:
CIAO CAPO is enjoying a good season, making it 3 wins from 5 starts when cosily taking a C&D handicap 17 days ago. He's fancied to make a bold bid to maintain his 100% record over C&D, with a trio of the older brigade in the shape of Sunny Orange, Distinction and Shimmering Sands fancied to be thereabouts. Market support behind Rapide Vega and/or Musical Accord would also look significant.

  1. CIAO CAPO (IRE)
  2. SUNNY ORANGE (IRE)
  3. DISTINCTION (IRE)

races.name: IRE-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SAFFRON BAY shaped encouragingly behind the odds-on winner when third at Lingfield on debut and she can build on that effort to get off the mark. She gets the vote ahead of Necromancer, who is respected for her leading yard, with Halcon also capable of getting involved given the promise she showed first time up.

  1. SAFFRON BAY (AUS)
  2. NECROMANCER
  3. HALCON

races.name: Churchill Tyres Handicap
races.verdict:
Having dropped a long way in the weights, SON came very close to cashing in at Carlisle 10 days ago, so he could be the answer. Highland Shah isn't yet exposed and he looks a big threat, with Supreme Clarets also of some interest.

  1. SON
  2. HIGHLAND SHAH (FR)
  3. SUPREME CLARETS (IRE)

races.name: Celebrate National Racehorse Week 2026 Handicap
races.verdict:
GLEN NEVIS showed improved form when beaten only by a progressive type at Newmarket 9 days ago, so he could be ready to go one better with cheekpieces now added. Next on the list is Mount King who wasted no time getting back to form at Redcar last week, with Borjina also considered having had excuses on her latest outing.

  1. GLEN NEVIS
  2. MOUNT KING (IRE)
  3. BORJINA

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BULLETSNAP has shaped well on both his starts and can take another step forward and make full use of the 4 lb he receives from Newmarket debut scorer Crown And Two. Tom Clover's gelding scored in good style there and rates a major threat though. Arthur Carrot and Blue Victory appeal as the pick of the rest for minor honours.

  1. BULLETSNAP (IRE)
  2. CROWN AND TWO
  3. ARTHUR CARROT

races.name: Total Task Consultancy Take The Reins Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
LEQUINTO can race off the same mark as when an unlucky third here recently so is fancied to bag a remarkable ninth course success. Supreme King also didn't enjoy the rub of the green when fifth at Chester last time and rates a big threat in his bid for a fifth victory of 2026. Both Amazonian Dream and Under The Twilight also possess excellent course records and can play a prominent role too in this competitive sprint.

  1. LEQUINTO (IRE)
  2. SUPREME KING (IRE)
  3. AMAZONIAN DREAM (IRE)

races.name: Total Task Consultancy Take The Reins Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
A few with chances but CRAFTY BLUE rates the pick of the weights on the back of an excellent Haydock second so is fancied to quickly resume winning ways and thwart the C&D hat-trick seeking Madman. Angel Gabriel is less exposed and could also have a say, with Moving Force completing the shortlist.

  1. CRAFTY BLUE (IRE)
  2. MADMAN
  3. ANGEL GABRIEL (IRE)

races.name: Remembering Gillian Rose Deane At 60 Nursery
races.verdict:
STONEY WOOD shaped well over an inadequate trip when sixth on his Lingfield nursery debut and looks very much the way to go now back over 6f with Billy Loughnane in the saddle. Crowned also looks to have better days ahead of him and is next on the list, with From Me To You and Vesper Honey also in the picture.

  1. STONEY WOOD (IRE)
  2. CROWNED (IRE)
  3. FROM ME TO YOU (IRE)

races.name: Weatherbys August Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
This listed event looks wide open but it could pay to side with WARRANT HOLDER who had looked firmly on the up until a beaten favourite in the John Smith's Cup at York and can bounce back in style having been freshened up since. Sea Scout is feared most on the back of an encouraging reappearance at Haydock, although both Respond and Tenability need factoring in too.

  1. WARRANT HOLDER (IRE)
  2. SEA SCOUT (IRE)
  3. RESPOND (IRE)

races.name: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
races.verdict:
MAXIMISING signalled he is ready to double his tally when returning from a break with a very good Kempton second (form been franked) so gets the vote in this competitive handicap. Eazy on The Eye heads the list of dangers after her narrow reverse over C&D last time, while Berry Clever and Bubbles Wonky seem sure to be on the premises too.

  1. MAXIMISING (IRE)
  2. EAZY ON THE EYE
  3. BERRY CLEVER

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 40 Pound In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and this looks a good opportunity for the handily-weighted GOLDFINDER to build on earlier promise and gain a first success if proving as effective on turf. Julia and Shelley Birkett's new recruit Regulus Black could emerge as the main danger, although both Lucky Sevens and Mister Pretentious can also have a say.

  1. GOLDFINDER
  2. REGULUS BLACK
  3. LUCKY SEVENS

races.name: Mountain Goat Tours Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MR LINCOLN has been running consistently well over hurdles and may be able to snap his losing sequence. Alvesta is 4 lb higher for his defeat of the selection last time and should go well again. Zamond, Ambassador, Mi Sueno and Lord of The Glance are others to consider in a competitive opener.

  1. MR LINCOLN
  2. ALVESTA
  3. ZAMOND (FR)

races.name: RF Miller & Co Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Hopefully the worst of the rain stays away for GAMBINO, who has strong claims to follow up last month's C&D success. Wheremyrosemarygoes stands out among the remainder.

  1. GAMBINO (IRE)
  2. WHERMYROSEMARYGOES (IRE)
  3. FAITHFUL GUARDIAN (IRE)

races.name: Hadwins Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
First-time blinkers and a change of stable could be the catalysts for an improved showing from ANOTHER PEARL. She's narrowly preferred to 3-time course winner Secret Secret, with Getaway Master potentially interesting on his return.

  1. ANOTHER PEARL
  2. SECRET SECRET (IRE)
  3. GETAWAY MASTER (IRE)

races.name: Molson Coors Cartmel Cup Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GOT GREY can land a fourth Cartmel Cup for local trainer James Moffatt. Banderas is expected to run another big race under Richie McLernon, while hat-trick seeking Roysse also makes plenty of appeal in a competitive renewal.

  1. GOT GREY (FR)
  2. BANDERAS (IRE)
  3. ROYSSE

races.name: BTRC Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PASSING DIAMOND looked a natural when accounting for a subsequent winner from 4 lb out of the weights on his chasing debut over C&D last month and is capable of following up on that evidence. Palamon has been considerately handled on both comeback runs this summer and needs keeping a close eye on in the betting, especially with Harry Skelton now back in the saddle.

  1. PASSING DIAMOND (IRE)
  2. PALAMON (IRE)
  3. LERMOOS LEGEND

races.name: Cengiz Sadik Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A mere 2 lb rise for last month's C&D success arguably underestimates AILL DUBH's superiority on the day and with his stable continuing to go well, he can follow up. A recent breathing operation may have helped Halfway House Lad and he's feared in a refitted tongue strap. Judicial Review is seeking a hat-trick in this race and completes the shortlist.

  1. AILL DUBH (IRE)
  2. HALFWAY HOUSE LAD
  3. JUDICIAL REVIEW (IRE)
